page.description: Tails 7.15.1 ISO: size, architecture and a SHA-256 computed by ROMinit.
page.intro: A live system that routes traffic through Tor and leaves no trace on the machine it runs on. It is written to a USB stick and booted; there is no installation.
pros: Tor routing and a fresh session on every boot.
Runs from a stick without touching the host disk.
Persistent storage is opt-in and encrypted.
Published as one image for amd64.
cons: It is a live system, not a general-purpose installed desktop.
Slower than a normal desktop because traffic goes through Tor.
The project publishes signatures and a verification add-on, not a SHA-256.
page.previewNote: A stock screenshot of the Tails 4.8 desktop from Wikimedia Commons. It is not 7.15.1 and not a ROMinit recording: no image was written and nothing was booted for this page.

page.status: One image: the amd64 ISO, written to a USB stick and booted. Writing erases the stick; the system does not install to the host disk. Its SHA-256 was computed by ROMinit from the official download on 2026-10-27; the project publishes signatures only. The date shown is the mirror file date (2026-10-22).
